```{r}
# Set working directory using forward slashes
#setwd("C:/Users/Khali/OneDrive/INN354/INN354 2025H Event log.csv")

# Import raw data from CSV
raw_data <- read.csv("INN354 2025H Event log.csv")

# Change time stamp format from character (example: 2020-07-14T17:36:34Z) to POSIXct
raw_data$timestamp <- as.POSIXct(strptime(raw_data$timestamp, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))
raw_data$invoice_date <- as.POSIXct(strptime(raw_data$invoice_date, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))
raw_data$scan_date <- as.POSIXct(strptime(raw_data$scan_date, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))

# Change variable type of invoice_id from integer to factor (otherwise the dotted charts will not work)
raw_data$invoice_id <- as.factor(raw_data$invoice_id)

# Create basic event log 
evlog <- eventlog(raw_data, 
                  case_id = "invoice_id",
                  activity_id = "activity_id", 
                  activity_instance_id = "event_id",
                  resource_id = "user_id",
                  timestamp = "timestamp", 
                  lifecycle_id = "lifecycle_id")

# Calculate some basic features of each case - very useful for further analysis (you may want to add more features of your own)
evlog %>% 
  group_by_case() %>% 
  summarise(
    n_events = n(), 
    n_users = n_distinct(user_id),
    invoice_date = first(invoice_date),
    start_date = min(timestamp),
    end_date = max(timestamp),
    end_event = last(activity_id),
    throughput_time_days = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(timestamp), units = "days")),
    days_from_invoice_date_to_end = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(invoice_date), units = "days")),
    first_approver = first(first_approver_id),
    second_approver = first(second_approver_id),
    spend_area = first(gl_account),
    vendor = first(vendor_id),
    cost_center = first(cost_center_id),
    profit_center = first(profit_center_id),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount),
    currency = first(currency_id),
    n_approvals = sum(activity_id == "Approved")
  ) %>%
  arrange(invoice_id, start_date) ->
  case_stats

# Write the case statistics to a CSV file for further analysis in other software
write.csv(case_stats, file = "INN354 2025H Case statistics.csv")
```

```{r}
# Import raw data from CSV
raw_data <- read.csv("INN354 2025H Event log.csv")

# Change time stamp format from character (example: 2020-07-14T17:36:34Z) to POSIXct
raw_data$timestamp <- as.POSIXct(strptime(raw_data$timestamp, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))
raw_data$invoice_date <- as.POSIXct(strptime(raw_data$invoice_date, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))
raw_data$scan_date <- as.POSIXct(strptime(raw_data$scan_date, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))

# Change variable type of invoice_id from integer to factor (otherwise the dotted charts will not work)
raw_data$invoice_id <- as.factor(raw_data$invoice_id)

# Create basic event log 
evlog <- eventlog(raw_data, 
                  case_id = "invoice_id",
                  activity_id = "activity_id", 
                  activity_instance_id = "event_id",
                  resource_id = "user_id",
                  timestamp = "timestamp", 
                  lifecycle_id = "lifecycle_id")

# Calculate some basic features of each case - very useful for further analysis (you may want to add more features of your own)
evlog %>% 
  group_by_case() %>% 
  summarise(
    n_events = n(), 
    n_users = n_distinct(user_id),
    invoice_date = first(invoice_date),
    start_date = min(timestamp),
    end_date = max(timestamp),
    end_event = last(activity_id),
    throughput_time_days = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(timestamp), units = "days")),
    days_from_invoice_date_to_end = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(invoice_date), units = "days")),
    first_approver = first(first_approver_id),
    second_approver = first(second_approver_id),
    spend_area = first(gl_account),
    vendor = first(vendor_id),
    cost_center = first(cost_center_id),
    profit_center = first(profit_center_id),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount),
    currency = first(currency_id),
    n_approvals = sum(activity_id == "Approved")
  ) %>%
  arrange(invoice_id, start_date) ->
  case_stats

# Write the case statistics to a CSV file for further analysis in other software
write.csv(case_stats, file = "INN354 2025H Case statistics.csv")
# Change time stamp format from character (example: 2020-07-14T17:36:34Z) to POSIXct

# Write the case statistics to a CSV file for further analysis in other software

  group_by_case() %>%

    # Existing metrics...
    n_events = n(),

    spend_area = first(gl_account),
    vendor = first(vendor_id),
    cost_center = first(cost_center_id),
    profit_center = first(profit_center_id),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount),
    currency = first(currency_id),
    n_approvals = sum(activity_id == "Approved"),
    
    # Additional useful metrics:
    has_second_approver = !is.na(first(second_approver_id)),
    was_rejected = any(activity_id == "Approval rejected"),
    was_on_hold = any(activity_id == "On hold at approver"),
    n_rejections = sum(activity_id == "Approval rejected"),
    processing_delay = as.numeric(difftime(min(timestamp), min(invoice_date), units = "days")),
    scan_to_process_days = as.numeric(difftime(min(timestamp), first(scan_date), units = "days")),
    # Categorize by amount for analysis
    amount_category = cut(first(invoice_amount), 
                        breaks = c(0, 1000, 10000, 50000, Inf),
                        labels = c("Small", "Medium", "Large", "Very Large"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(invoice_id, start_date)

# Import raw data
raw_data <- read.csv("INN354 2025H Event log.csv")

# Data cleaning and formatting
raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(strptime(timestamp, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")),
    invoice_date = as.POSIXct(strptime(invoice_date, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")),
    scan_date = as.POSIXct(strptime(scan_date, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")),
    invoice_id = as.factor(invoice_id),
    # Create process stage categories
    process_stage = case_when(
      activity_id %in% c("Data management", "Get goods receipt from WM", "Initial validation") ~ "Preparation",
      activity_id %in% c("Sent for approval", "On hold at approver") ~ "Approval",
      activity_id %in% c("Approved", "Approval rejected") ~ "Decision",
      activity_id %in% c("FI Posted Automatically", "Posted manually") ~ "Posting",
      activity_id == "Invoice document deleted" ~ "Exception",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    # Flag high-value invoices (above 500,000 threshold)
    high_value = invoice_amount > 500000,
    # Calculate processing delays
    scan_to_process_days = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, scan_date, units = "days"))
  )

# Create event log
evlog <- eventlog(raw_data, 
                 case_id = "invoice_id",
                 activity_id = "activity_id", 
                 activity_instance_id = "event_id",
                 resource_id = "user_id",
                 timestamp = "timestamp", 
                 lifecycle_id = "lifecycle_id")

cat("Data imported successfully:", nrow(raw_data), "events,", n_distinct(raw_data$invoice_id), "cases\n")
## Data imported successfully: 346999 events, 57417 cases
# 2. PROCESS OVERVIEW AND BASIC STATISTICS
cat("\n=== STEP 2: PROCESS OVERVIEW ===\n")
## 
## === STEP 2: PROCESS OVERVIEW ===
# Basic process statistics
process_summary <- evlog %>%
  group_by_case() %>%
  summarise(
    n_events = n(),
    n_users = n_distinct(user_id),
    invoice_date = first(invoice_date),
    start_date = min(timestamp),
    end_date = max(timestamp),
    final_status = last(activity_id),
    throughput_time_days = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(timestamp), units = "days")),
    processing_time_from_invoice = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(invoice_date), units = "days")),
    first_approver = first(first_approver_id),
    second_approver = first(second_approver_id),
    gl_account = first(gl_account),
    vendor = first(vendor_id),
    cost_center = first(cost_center_id),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount),
    currency = first(currency_id),
    n_approvals = sum(activity_id == "Approved"),
    n_rejections = sum(activity_id == "Approval rejected"),
    has_rework = any(activity_id %in% c("Approval rejected", "On hold at approver")),
    has_manual_posting = any(activity_id == "Posted manually")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    process_complexity = case_when(
      n_events <= 3 ~ "Simple",
      n_events <= 6 ~ "Medium",
      TRUE ~ "Complex"
    )
  )

# Save case statistics
write.csv(process_summary, "INN354_case_statistics_detailed.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 5. THROUGHPUT TIME AND BOTTLENECK ANALYSIS
cat("\n=== STEP 5: THROUGHPUT TIME ANALYSIS ===\n")
## 
## === STEP 5: THROUGHPUT TIME ANALYSIS ===
# Overall throughput statistics
throughput_stats <- process_summary %>%
  summarise(
    avg_throughput_days = mean(throughput_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_throughput_days = median(throughput_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_throughput_days = min(throughput_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_throughput_days = max(throughput_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    std_throughput_days = sd(throughput_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_cases = n()
  )

print("Throughput Time Statistics (Days):")

print(throughput_stats)

##                 <dbl>                  <dbl>               <dbl>
## 1                8.89                   4.50                   0
## # ℹ 3 more variables: max_throughput_days <dbl>, std_throughput_days <dbl>,
## #   total_cases <int>
# Bottleneck analysis by process stage
stage_durations <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id, process_stage) %>%
  summarise(
    stage_start = min(timestamp),
    stage_end = max(timestamp),
    stage_duration_days = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(timestamp), units = "days"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(process_stage) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_duration_days = mean(stage_duration_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_duration_days = median(stage_duration_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_duration_days = min(stage_duration_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_duration_days = max(stage_duration_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    cases = n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_duration_days))

print("Bottleneck Analysis by Process Stage:")

cat("\n=== STEP 6: APPROVAL PROCESS ANALYSIS ===\n")
## 
## === STEP 6: APPROVAL PROCESS ANALYSIS ===
# Approval cycle analysis
approval_analysis <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  filter(any(activity_id == "Sent for approval")) %>%
  summarise(
    approval_sent_time = min(timestamp[activity_id == "Sent for approval"]),
    approval_decision_time = min(timestamp[activity_id %in% c("Approved", "Approval rejected")]),
    approval_response_days = as.numeric(difftime(approval_decision_time, approval_sent_time, units = "days")),
    approval_outcome = first(activity_id[activity_id %in% c("Approved", "Approval rejected")]),
    n_approval_cycles = sum(activity_id == "Sent for approval")
  )

approval_stats <- approval_analysis %>%
  summarise(
    avg_approval_time_days = mean(approval_response_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_approval_time_days = median(approval_response_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_approval_time_days = min(approval_response_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_approval_time_days = max(approval_response_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    approval_rate = sum(approval_outcome == "Approved", na.rm = TRUE) / n() * 100,
    reapproval_rate = mean(n_approval_cycles > 1) * 100,
    total_approval_cases = n()
  )

print("Approval Process Statistics:")

print(approval_stats)

# Create key visualizations
create_visualizations <- function() {
  
  # Throughput time distribution
  p1 <- ggplot(process_summary, aes(x = throughput_time_days)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Invoice Processing Times",
         subtitle = "Elkjøp Nordic Accounts Payable Process",
         x = "Processing Time (Days)", y = "Number of Invoices") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave("throughput_distribution.png", p1, width = 10, height = 6)
  
  # Process stage duration comparison
  p2 <- ggplot(stage_durations, aes(x = reorder(process_stage, -avg_duration_days), y = avg_duration_days)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "coral", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Average Duration by Process Stage",
         subtitle = "Identifying Process Bottlenecks",
         x = "Process Stage", y = "Average Duration (Days)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  ggsave("stage_durations.png", p2, width = 10, height = 6)
  
  # Approval response time analysis
  if(nrow(approval_analysis) > 0) {
    p3 <- ggplot(approval_analysis, aes(x = approval_response_days)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
      labs(title = "Approval Response Time Distribution",
           subtitle = "Analysis of Approval Process Efficiency",
           x = "Approval Response Time (Days)", y = "Number of Invoices") +
      theme_minimal()
    
    ggsave("approval_times.png", p3, width = 10, height = 6)
  }
  
  # Activity frequency
  p4 <- ggplot(activity_freq %>% head(15), aes(x = reorder(activity_id, n), y = n)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "purple", alpha = 0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Most Frequent Activities",
         subtitle = "Process Activity Distribution",
         x = "Activity", y = "Frequency") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave("activity_frequency.png", p4, width = 10, height = 6)
  
  # Process complexity analysis
  p5 <- ggplot(process_summary, aes(x = process_complexity)) +
    geom_bar(fill = "orange", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Process Complexity Distribution",
         subtitle = "Classification by Number of Activities per Case",
         x = "Process Complexity", y = "Number of Invoices") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave("process_complexity.png", p5, width = 10, height = 6)
}

# Generate visualizations
create_visualizations()

# GRAPH 1: PROCESSING TIME DISTRIBUTION
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

# Load and prepare data
raw_data <- read.csv("INN354 2025H Event log.csv")
raw_data$timestamp <- as.POSIXct(strptime(raw_data$timestamp, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))
raw_data$invoice_date <- as.POSIXct(strptime(raw_data$invoice_date, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))

# Calculate throughput times
throughput_data <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  summarise(
    throughput_days = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(timestamp), units = "days")),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount)
  )

# Create histogram
p1 <- ggplot(throughput_data, aes(x = throughput_days)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#2E86AB", alpha = 0.8, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(throughput_days, na.rm = TRUE)), 
             color = "#A23B72", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Invoice Processing Time Distribution",
    subtitle = "Elkjop Nordic Accounts Payable Process",
    x = "Processing Time (Days)",
    y = "Number of Invoices",
    caption = paste("Median processing time:", round(median(throughput_data$throughput_days, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "days")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40")
  )

print(p1)


ggsave("1_throughput_time_distribution.png", p1, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
# GRAPH 4: PROCESS STAGE DURATION ANALYSIS
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Define process stages
stage_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    process_stage = case_when(
      activity_id %in% c("Data management", "Get goods receipt from WM", "Initial validation") ~ "Preparation",
      activity_id %in% c("Sent for approval", "On hold at approver") ~ "Approval",
      activity_id %in% c("Approved", "Approval rejected") ~ "Decision",
      activity_id %in% c("FI Posted Automatically", "Posted manually") ~ "Posting",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(invoice_id, process_stage) %>%
  summarise(
    stage_duration = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(timestamp), units = "days"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(process_stage) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_duration = mean(stage_duration, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Create stage duration plot
p4 <- ggplot(stage_data, aes(x = reorder(process_stage, -avg_duration), y = avg_duration)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#FF6B6B", alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Duration by Process Stage",
    subtitle = "Identifying bottlenecks in AP process",
    x = "Process Stage",
    y = "Average Duration (Days)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p4)
```

```{r}
# ANALYSIS OF INVOICES GOING TO FI MANUAL PROCESSING
cat("=== ANALYSIS OF INVOICES FOR FI MANUAL PROCESSING ===\n")

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# Load and prepare data
raw_data <- read.csv("INN354 2025H Event log.csv")
raw_data$timestamp <- as.POSIXct(strptime(raw_data$timestamp, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))
raw_data$invoice_date <- as.POSIXct(strptime(raw_data$invoice_date, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))

# Identify invoices that go to FI manual processing
manual_processing_invoices <- raw_data %>%
  filter(activity_id == "FI for Manual processing after initial check") %>%
  distinct(invoice_id) %>%
  pull(invoice_id)

cat("Number of invoices going to FI manual processing:", length(manual_processing_invoices), "\n")

# Get detailed data for manual processing invoices
manual_processing_data <- raw_data %>%
  filter(invoice_id %in% manual_processing_invoices) %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  summarise(
    vendor_id = first(vendor_id),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount),
    gl_account = first(gl_account),
    cost_center = first(cost_center_id),
    currency = first(currency_id),
    first_approver = first(first_approver_id),
    process_start = min(timestamp),
    process_end = max(timestamp),
    n_activities = n(),
    has_approval_rejection = any(activity_id == "Approval rejected"),
    has_on_hold = any(activity_id == "On hold at approver"),
    final_status = last(activity_id)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    processing_days = as.numeric(difftime(process_end, process_start, units = "days"))
  )

# 1. AMOUNT ANALYSIS FOR MANUAL PROCESSING INVOICES
cat("\n=== 1. AMOUNT ANALYSIS ===\n")

amount_analysis <- manual_processing_data %>%
  summarise(
    total_invoices = n(),
    avg_amount = mean(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_amount = median(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_amount = min(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_amount = max(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_amount = sum(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    std_dev_amount = sd(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print("Manual Processing Invoice Amount Statistics:")
print(amount_analysis)

# Amount distribution by categories
amount_categories <- manual_processing_data %>%
  mutate(
    amount_category = case_when(
      invoice_amount <= 1000 ~ "Small (≤1,000)",
      invoice_amount <= 10000 ~ "Medium (1,001-10,000)",
      invoice_amount <= 50000 ~ "Large (10,001-50,000)",
      invoice_amount <= 100000 ~ "Very Large (50,001-100,000)",
      TRUE ~ "Extreme (>100,000)"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(amount_category, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)

print("Manual Processing Invoices by Amount Category:")
print(amount_categories)

# 2. SUPPLIER/VENDOR ANALYSIS FOR MANUAL PROCESSING
cat("\n=== 2. SUPPLIER/VENDOR ANALYSIS ===\n")

vendor_analysis <- manual_processing_data %>%
  group_by(vendor_id) %>%
  summarise(
    invoice_count = n(),
    total_amount = sum(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_amount = mean(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_amount = median(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_amount = min(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_amount = max(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    percentage_of_total_manual = n() / nrow(manual_processing_data) * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(invoice_count))

print("Top 20 Suppliers by Manual Processing Volume:")
print(vendor_analysis %>% head(20))

# Vendor concentration analysis
vendor_concentration <- vendor_analysis %>%
  summarise(
    total_vendors = n_distinct(vendor_id),
    top_10_vendor_coverage = sum(head(invoice_count, 10)) / sum(invoice_count) * 100,
    top_20_vendor_coverage = sum(head(invoice_count, 20)) / sum(invoice_count) * 100,
    avg_invoices_per_vendor = mean(invoice_count),
    median_invoices_per_vendor = median(invoice_count)
  )
```

```{r}
# GL ACCOUNT ANALYSIS PLOTS FOR MANUAL PROCESSING INVOICES
cat("=== GL ACCOUNT ANALYSIS VISUALIZATIONS ===\n")

# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(forcats)

# Calculate GL account statistics for manual processing invoices
gl_account_analysis <- manual_processing_data %>%
  group_by(gl_account) %>%
  summarise(
    invoice_count = n(),
    total_amount = sum(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_amount = mean(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(invoice_count))

# Filter for meaningful analysis (remove NA and very small counts)
gl_account_analysis_clean <- gl_account_analysis %>%
  filter(!is.na(gl_account) & invoice_count >= 5) %>%
  arrange(desc(invoice_count))

cat("GL Accounts with significant manual processing volume:", nrow(gl_account_analysis_clean), "\n")

# PLOT 1: TOP GL ACCOUNTS BY INVOICE COUNT
p1 <- ggplot(gl_account_analysis_clean %>% head(15), 
             aes(x = fct_reorder(gl_account, invoice_count), y = invoice_count)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#2E86AB", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = invoice_count), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top GL Accounts by Manual Processing Volume",
    subtitle = "General Ledger accounts with highest number of manual processing invoices",
    x = "GL Account",
    y = "Number of Invoices"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "#2E86AB"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray40"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))

#print(p1)
ggsave("gl_account_invoice_count.png", p1, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 2: TOP GL ACCOUNTS BY TOTAL AMOUNT
p2 <- ggplot(gl_account_analysis_clean %>% 
               arrange(desc(total_amount)) %>% 
               head(15), 
             aes(x = fct_reorder(gl_account, total_amount), y = total_amount)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#A23B72", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(round(total_amount))), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top GL Accounts by Total Manual Processing Amount",
    subtitle = "General Ledger accounts with highest total value of manual processing invoices",
    x = "GL Account",
    y = "Total Amount"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "#A23B72"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray40"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))

#print(p2)
ggsave("gl_account_total_amount.png", p2, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 3: TOP GL ACCOUNTS BY AVERAGE AMOUNT
p3 <- ggplot(gl_account_analysis_clean %>% 
               arrange(desc(avg_amount)) %>% 
               head(15), 
             aes(x = fct_reorder(gl_account, avg_amount), y = avg_amount)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#F18F01", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(round(avg_amount))), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top GL Accounts by Average Invoice Amount",
    subtitle = "General Ledger accounts with highest average value per manual processing invoice",
    x = "GL Account",
    y = "Average Invoice Amount"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "#F18F01"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray40"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))

#print(p3)
ggsave("gl_account_avg_amount.png", p3, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 4: BUBBLE CHART - RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN COUNT, TOTAL AMOUNT, AND AVERAGE AMOUNT
top_gl_accounts <- gl_account_analysis_clean %>% head(20)

p4 <- ggplot(top_gl_accounts, 
             aes(x = invoice_count, y = total_amount, size = avg_amount, color = gl_account)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = gl_account), hjust = -0.2, vjust = 0.5, size = 3, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Average Amount", range = c(3, 10), labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "GL Account Analysis: Volume vs Value Relationship",
    subtitle = "Bubble size represents average invoice amount",
    x = "Number of Invoices (Volume)",
    y = "Total Amount (Value)",
    size = "Average Amount"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

#print(p4)
ggsave("gl_account_bubble_chart.png", p4, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 5: HEATMAP STYLE - COMPREHENSIVE VIEW
p5 <- ggplot(top_gl_accounts, 
             aes(x = invoice_count, y = reorder(gl_account, invoice_count))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = total_amount, color = avg_amount), alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Total Amount", range = c(3, 12), labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_color_gradient(name = "Average Amount", low = "#FF6B6B", high = "#4ECDC4", labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "GL Account Risk & Impact Matrix",
    subtitle = "Size = Total Amount, Color = Average Amount",
    x = "Number of Invoices (Frequency)",
    y = "GL Account"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical"
  )

#print(p5)
ggsave("gl_account_heatmap.png", p5, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 6: PIE CHART - DISTRIBUTION OF MANUAL PROCESSING BY TOP GL ACCOUNTS
top_10_gl <- gl_account_analysis_clean %>% head(10)
other_gl <- data.frame(
  gl_account = "Other GL Accounts",
  invoice_count = sum(gl_account_analysis_clean$invoice_count[11:nrow(gl_account_analysis_clean)]),
  total_amount = sum(gl_account_analysis_clean$total_amount[11:nrow(gl_account_analysis_clean)]),
  avg_amount = NA
)

pie_data <- bind_rows(top_10_gl, other_gl) %>%
  mutate(percentage = invoice_count / sum(invoice_count) * 100)

p6 <- ggplot(pie_data, aes(x = "", y = invoice_count, fill = fct_reorder(gl_account, invoice_count))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%")), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "GL Account") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Manual Processing by GL Account",
    subtitle = "Top 10 GL accounts and remaining accounts",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

#print(p6)
ggsave("gl_account_pie_chart.png", p6, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 7: FACETED ANALYSIS - COMPARING METRICS ACROSS TOP GL ACCOUNTS
top_8_gl <- gl_account_analysis_clean %>% head(8)

facet_data <- top_8_gl %>%
  select(gl_account, invoice_count, total_amount, avg_amount) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(invoice_count, total_amount, avg_amount), 
                      names_to = "metric", 
                      values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(metric, 
                   levels = c("invoice_count", "total_amount", "avg_amount"),
                   labels = c("Invoice Count", "Total Amount", "Average Amount"))
  )

p7 <- ggplot(facet_data, aes(x = reorder(gl_account, value), y = value, fill = metric)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2E86AB", "#A23B72", "#F18F01")) +
  labs(
    title = "Comprehensive GL Account Analysis",
    subtitle = "Comparison across three key metrics",
    x = "GL Account",
    y = "Value",
    fill = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma)

#print(p7)
ggsave("gl_account_faceted.png", p7, width = 10, height = 12, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 8: TREEMAP VISUALIZATION
library(treemapify)

p8 <- ggplot(top_10_gl, 
             aes(area = total_amount, fill = avg_amount, 
                 label = paste0(gl_account, "\n", scales::comma(round(total_amount))))) +
  geom_treemap(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_treemap_text(color = "white", fontface = "bold", place = "center", grow = TRUE) +

  )

#print(p8)

# SUMMARY STATISTICS
```

```{r}
# PROCESSING TIME STATISTICS VISUALIZATIONS

# Load required libraries

# Calculate processing time statistics

  summarise(
    avg_processing_days = mean(processing_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_processing_days = median(processing_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_processing_days = min(processing_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_processing_days = max(processing_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    std_dev_days = sd(processing_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    p95_processing_days = quantile(processing_days, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75_processing_days = quantile(processing_days, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),

cat("Median Processing Time:", round(processing_stats$median_processing_days, 1), "days\n")
cat("Standard Deviation:", round(processing_stats$std_dev_days, 1), "days\n")
cat("Range:", round(processing_stats$min_processing_days, 1), "to", round(processing_stats$max_processing_days, 1), "days\n")

# Calculate efficiency metrics
efficiency_metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Process Consistency", "Outlier Impact", "SLA Compliance"),
  Value = c(
    # Process consistency (lower std dev relative to mean is better)
    ifelse(processing_stats$std_dev_days / processing_stats$avg_processing_days < 0.5, "Good", "Needs Improvement"),
    # Outlier impact (difference between avg and median)
    ifelse(abs(processing_stats$avg_processing_days - processing_stats$median_processing_days) < 2, "Low", "High"),
    # SLA compliance (assuming 7-day target)
    ifelse(processing_stats$p95_processing_days <= target_sla, "Good", "Needs Improvement")
  )
)

print("Efficiency Assessment:")
print(efficiency_metrics)
```

```{r}
# Analyze goods receipt integration patterns
wm_integration_analysis <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  summarise(
    has_goods_receipt = any(activity_id == "Get goods receipt from WM"),
    goods_receipt_timing = ifelse(
      has_goods_receipt,
      as.numeric(difftime(
        min(timestamp[activity_id == "Get goods receipt from WM"]),
        min(timestamp), 
        units = "days"
      )),
      NA
    ),
    integration_success = any(activity_id == "FI Posted Automatically" & has_goods_receipt),
    manual_fallback = any(activity_id == "Posted manually" & has_goods_receipt)
  )

integration_stats <- wm_integration_analysis %>%
  summarise(
    total_cases_with_wm = sum(has_goods_receipt, na.rm = TRUE),
    integration_success_rate = mean(integration_success, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    manual_fallback_rate = mean(manual_fallback, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    avg_integration_delay_days = mean(goods_receipt_timing, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
# FOCUSED ANALYSIS: MANUAL PROCESSING, WM INTEGRATION & FAILED AUTOMATIC POSTINGS
cat("=== FOCUSED ANALYSIS: MANUAL PROCESSING & INTEGRATION ISSUES ===\n")

# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(lubridate)
library(bupaR)

# 1. MANUAL POSTING ANALYSIS
cat("\n1. MANUAL POSTING ANALYSIS\n")

# Filter for manual processing cases
manual_processing_cases <- raw_data %>%
  filter(activity_id %in% c("Posted manually", "FI for Manual processing after initial check")) %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_manual_activities = n(),
    manual_activities = paste(unique(activity_id), collapse = ", "),
    total_activities = n_distinct(event_id),
    manual_posting_time = first(timestamp[activity_id == "Posted manually"]),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount),
    vendor = first(vendor_id),
    gl_account = first(gl_account),
    user_responsible = first(user_id[activity_id == "Posted manually"])
  )

# Manual posting reasons and patterns
manual_analysis <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  mutate(
    has_manual_posting = any(activity_id == "Posted manually"),
    has_manual_processing_flag = any(activity_id == "FI for Manual processing after initial check")
  ) %>%
  filter(has_manual_posting | has_manual_processing_flag) %>%
  summarise(
    final_status = last(activity_id),
    process_path = paste(activity_id, collapse = " -> "),
    n_activities = n(),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount),
    vendor = first(vendor_id),
    gl_account = first(gl_account),
    manual_reason = case_when(
      any(activity_id == "Approval rejected") ~ "Approval Rejection",
      any(activity_id == "On hold at approver") ~ "Approval Hold",
      any(activity_id == "Get goods receipt from WM") ~ "Goods Receipt Issue",
      n_activities > 6 ~ "Complex Process",
      invoice_amount > 500000 ~ "High Value",
      TRUE ~ "Other Exception"
    )
  )

print("Manual Posting Summary:")
manual_summary <- manual_analysis %>%
  count(manual_reason, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)
print(manual_summary)

# 2. GOODS RECEIPT WM INTEGRATION ISSUES
cat("\n2. GOODS RECEIPT WM INTEGRATION ANALYSIS\n")

# Analyze WM integration patterns
wm_integration_cases <- raw_data %>%
  filter(activity_id == "Get goods receipt from WM") %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  summarise(
    wm_activity_time = first(timestamp),
    wm_user = first(user_id),
    vendor = first(vendor_id),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount),
    # Check what happens after WM activity
    next_activities = paste(lead(activity_id), collapse = ", "),
    has_issues = any(lead(activity_id) %in% c("Posted manually", "Approval rejected", "On hold at approver"))
  )

wm_issues_summary <- wm_integration_cases %>%
  summarise(
    total_wm_cases = n(),
    cases_with_issues = sum(has_issues),
    issue_rate = mean(has_issues) * 100,
    common_vendors = names(sort(table(vendor), decreasing = TRUE)[1:5])
  )

print("WM Integration Issues Summary:")
print(wm_issues_summary)

# 3. FAILED AUTOMATIC POSTINGS
cat("\n3. FAILED AUTOMATIC POSTING ANALYSIS\n")

# Identify cases where automatic posting failed
failed_auto_cases <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  mutate(
    has_auto_posting_attempt = any(activity_id == "FI Posted Automatically"),
    ends_with_manual = last(activity_id) == "Posted manually",
    has_manual_intervention = any(activity_id %in% c("FI for Manual processing after initial check", "Posted manually"))
  ) %>%
  filter(has_auto_posting_attempt & has_manual_intervention) %>%
  summarise(
    auto_posting_time = first(timestamp[activity_id == "FI Posted Automatically"]),
    manual_intervention_time = first(timestamp[activity_id %in% c("FI for Manual processing after initial check", "Posted manually")]),
    time_to_manual_intervention = as.numeric(difftime(manual_intervention_time, auto_posting_time, units = "days")),
    vendor = first(vendor_id),
    gl_account = first(gl_account),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount),
    process_path = paste(activity_id, collapse = " -> ")
  )

print("Failed Automatic Posting Summary:")
failed_auto_summary <- failed_auto_cases %>%
  summarise(
    total_cases = n(),
    avg_time_to_intervention = mean(time_to_manual_intervention, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_time_to_intervention = median(time_to_manual_intervention, na.rm = TRUE),
    high_value_cases = sum(invoice_amount > 500000)
  )
print(failed_auto_summary)

# VISUALIZATIONS
cat("\n4. CREATING SPECIALIZED VISUALIZATIONS\n")

# PLOT 1: MANUAL POSTING REASONS BREAKDOWN
p1 <- ggplot(manual_summary, aes(x = reorder(manual_reason, n), y = n, fill = manual_reason)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%")), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Manual Posting Reasons Breakdown",
    subtitle = "Primary causes requiring manual intervention in invoice processing",
    x = "Reason for Manual Processing",
    y = "Number of Invoices",
    fill = "Reason"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3")

ggsave("manual_posting_reasons.png", p1, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 2: WM INTEGRATION ISSUES BY VENDOR
wm_vendor_issues <- wm_integration_cases %>%
  group_by(vendor) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cases = n(),
    issue_cases = sum(has_issues),
    issue_rate = (issue_cases / total_cases) * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(total_cases >= 10) %>%  # Only vendors with significant volume
  arrange(desc(issue_rate)) %>%
  head(15)

p2 <- ggplot(wm_vendor_issues, aes(x = reorder(vendor, issue_rate), y = issue_rate)) +

  ) +

ggsave("wm_integration_issues_by_vendor.png", p2, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 3: FAILED AUTO POSTING TIME TO RESOLUTION
p3 <- ggplot(failed_auto_cases, aes(x = time_to_manual_intervention)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#F39C12", alpha = 0.8, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(time_to_manual_intervention, na.rm = TRUE)), 
             color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Time to Manual Intervention After Failed Automatic Posting",
    subtitle = "Delay between automatic posting failure and manual resolution",
    x = "Time to Manual Intervention (Days)",
    y = "Number of Invoices",
    caption = paste("Median resolution time:", 
                   round(median(failed_auto_cases$time_to_manual_intervention, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "days")
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("failed_auto_posting_resolution_time.png", p3, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 4: MANUAL VS AUTOMATIC PROCESSING COMPARISON
processing_comparison <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  summarise(
    processing_type = case_when(
      any(activity_id == "Posted manually") ~ "Manual",
      any(activity_id == "FI Posted Automatically") ~ "Automatic",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    throughput_days = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(timestamp), units = "days")),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount),
    n_activities = n()
  ) %>%
  filter(processing_type %in% c("Manual", "Automatic"))

p4 <- ggplot(processing_comparison, aes(x = processing_type, y = throughput_days, fill = processing_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_y_log10() +  # Log scale for better visualization
  labs(
    title = "Processing Time: Manual vs Automatic Posting",
    subtitle = "Comparison of throughput times for different processing methods",
    x = "Processing Type",
    y = "Processing Time (Days - Log Scale)",
    fill = "Processing Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Manual" = "#E74C3C", "Automatic" = "#27AE60"))

ggsave("manual_vs_automatic_processing.png", p4, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 5: MANUAL POSTING TREND OVER TIME
manual_trend <- raw_data %>%
  filter(activity_id == "Posted manually") %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(timestamp, "month")) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(manual_count = n_distinct(invoice_id))

p5 <- ggplot(manual_trend, aes(x = month, y = manual_count)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2, color = "#E74C3C") +

  labs(
    title = "Manual Posting Trend Over Time",

    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of Manual Postings"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("manual_posting_trend.png", p5, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 6: GL ACCOUNTS WITH HIGHEST MANUAL PROCESSING
gl_manual_analysis <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  filter(any(activity_id == "Posted manually")) %>%
  group_by(gl_account) %>%
  summarise(
    manual_count = n_distinct(invoice_id),
    avg_amount = mean(first(invoice_amount), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(manual_count)) %>%
  head(15)

p6 <- ggplot(gl_manual_analysis, aes(x = reorder(gl_account, manual_count), y = manual_count)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#8E44AD", alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "GL Accounts with Highest Manual Processing",
    subtitle = "General Ledger accounts requiring most manual intervention",
    x = "GL Account",
    y = "Number of Manual Postings"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("gl_accounts_manual_processing.png", p6, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# DETAILED ANALYSIS REPORTS
cat("\n5. GENERATING DETAILED ANALYSIS REPORTS\n")

# Manual Processing Deep Dive
manual_detailed <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  filter(any(activity_id %in% c("Posted manually", "FI for Manual processing after initial check"))) %>%
  summarise(
    process_sequence = paste(activity_id, collapse = " -> "),
    final_status = last(activity_id),
    total_activities = n(),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount),
    vendor = first(vendor_id),
    gl_account = first(gl_account),
    has_wm_integration = any(activity_id == "Get goods receipt from WM"),
    has_approval_issues = any(activity_id %in% c("Approval rejected", "On hold at approver")),
    processing_days = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(timestamp), units = "days"))
  )

# WM Integration Failure Analysis
wm_failure_patterns <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  filter(any(activity_id == "Get goods receipt from WM")) %>%
  summarise(
    wm_position = which(activity_id == "Get goods receipt from WM")[1],
    activities_after_wm = paste(activity_id[wm_position:length(activity_id)], collapse = " -> "),
    has_manual_after_wm = any(activity_id[wm_position:length(activity_id)] == "Posted manually"),
    vendor = first(vendor_id),
    processing_outcome = last(activity_id)
  )

# Save detailed analysis files
write.csv(manual_summary, "manual_posting_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(wm_integration_cases, "wm_integration_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(failed_auto_cases, "failed_automatic_posting_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(manual_detailed, "manual_processing_detailed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(wm_failure_patterns, "wm_failure_patterns.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# KEY INSIGHTS SUMMARY
cat("\n=== KEY INSIGHTS: MANUAL PROCESSING & INTEGRATION ISSUES ===\n")

manual_insights <- list(
  total_manual_cases = nrow(manual_analysis),
  manual_processing_rate = round(nrow(manual_analysis) / n_distinct(raw_data$invoice_id) * 100, 2),
  top_manual_reason = manual_summary$manual_reason[1],
  wm_integration_issue_rate = round(wm_issues_summary$issue_rate, 2),
  avg_failed_auto_resolution_time = round(mean(failed_auto_cases$time_to_manual_intervention, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  high_value_manual_cases = sum(manual_analysis$invoice_amount > 500000, na.rm = TRUE)
)

print("Critical Issues Identified:")
print(manual_insights)

cat("\n=== RECOMMENDATIONS ===\n")
recommendations <- data.frame(
  Issue = c("High Manual Posting Rate", "WM Integration Failures", "Failed Automatic Postings", "GL Account Issues"),
  Recommendation = c(
    "Implement validation rules to catch issues before posting; train vendors on invoice requirements",
    "Improve WM system integration; create vendor certification program for WM compliance",
    "Enhance automatic posting logic; implement real-time exception alerts",
    "Review and standardize GL account usage; provide training on proper account selection"
  ),
  Expected_Impact = c("Reduce manual work by 40-60%", "Decrease WM issues by 50%", "Improve auto-posting success by 30%", "Reduce GL-related errors by 70%")
)

print(recommendations)

cat("\n=== ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Generated 6 specialized visualizations and 5 detailed analysis files\n")
cat("Focus areas: Manual processing reasons, WM integration issues, failed automatic postings\n")
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(bupaR)
library(scales)

# Set working directory
#setwd("C:/Users/Khali/Desktop/INN351 and INN354/INN354")

# Import data
raw_data <- read.csv("INN354 2025H Event log.csv")
raw_data$timestamp <- as.POSIXct(strptime(raw_data$timestamp, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))

# ANALYSIS 1: FI MANUAL PROCESSING STEPS
cat("=== FI MANUAL PROCESSING ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Filter for manual processing cases
manual_processing_cases <- raw_data %>%
  filter(activity_id == "Posted manually") %>%
  distinct(invoice_id) %>%
  pull(invoice_id)

# Get complete event logs for manual processing cases
manual_cases_data <- raw_data %>%
  filter(invoice_id %in% manual_processing_cases)

# Manual processing statistics
manual_stats <- manual_cases_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_activities = n(),
    processing_days = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(timestamp), units = "days")),
    has_rejection = any(activity_id == "Approval rejected"),
    has_hold = any(activity_id == "On hold at approver"),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount),
    vendor = first(vendor_id),
    gl_account = first(gl_account),
    final_status = last(activity_id)
  )

# PLOT 1: MANUAL PROCESSING REASONS ANALYSIS
manual_reasons <- manual_cases_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  summarise(
    had_rejection = any(activity_id == "Approval rejected"),
    had_hold = any(activity_id == "On hold at approver"),
    had_comment_request = any(activity_id == "Asked for Comment"),
    n_approval_cycles = sum(activity_id == "Sent for approval")
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    rejection_rate = mean(had_rejection) * 100,
    hold_rate = mean(had_hold) * 100,
    comment_rate = mean(had_comment_request) * 100,
    multiple_approvals_rate = mean(n_approval_cycles > 1) * 100
  )

reason_data <- data.frame(
  Reason = c("Approval Rejection", "On Hold", "Comment Request", "Multiple Approvals"),
  Percentage = as.numeric(manual_reasons[1, ])
)

p1 <- ggplot(reason_data, aes(x = reorder(Reason, -Percentage), y = Percentage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#E74C3C", alpha = 2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%")), vjust = -0.5, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  labs(
    title = "Root Causes of Manual Posting Requirements",
    subtitle = "Percentage of manually posted invoices experiencing each issue",
    x = "Process Issue",
    y = "Percentage of Manual Postings (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 14)
  )

print(p1)
ggsave("manual_posting_reasons.png", p1, width = 8, height = 2, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(treemap)
library(forcats)

# Set working directory
#setwd("C:/Users/Khali/Desktop/INN351 and INN354/INN354")

# Import data
raw_data <- read.csv("INN354 2025H Event log.csv")
raw_data$timestamp <- as.POSIXct(strptime(raw_data$timestamp, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))

# ANALYSIS: LARGEST INVOICE TYPES THAT FAIL
cat("=== LARGEST INVOICE TYPES FAILURE ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Define failure criteria
failed_cases <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  summarise(
    final_status = last(activity_id),
    has_manual_posting = any(activity_id == "Posted manually"),
    has_rejection = any(activity_id == "Approval rejected"),
    has_hold = any(activity_id == "On hold at approver"),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount),
    vendor_id = first(vendor_id),
    gl_account = first(gl_account),
    cost_center = first(cost_center_id),
    profit_center = first(profit_center_id),
    currency = first(currency_id),
    n_activities = n(),
    processing_days = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(timestamp), units = "days"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    failure_type = case_when(
      has_rejection ~ "Approval Rejected",
      has_hold ~ "On Hold at Approver",
      has_manual_posting & !final_status %in% c("FI Posted Automatically", "Posted manually") ~ "Manual Intervention Required",
      final_status == "Invoice document deleted" ~ "Invoice Deleted",
      processing_days > 30 ~ "Extended Processing Time",
      TRUE ~ "Successful"
    ),
    is_failure = failure_type != "Successful",
    amount_category = cut(invoice_amount,
                         breaks = c(0, 1000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 500000, 1000000, Inf),
                         labels = c("Small (<1K)", "Medium (1K-10K)", "Large (10K-50K)", 
                                   "Major (50K-100K)", "Strategic (100K-500K)", 
                                   "Critical (500K-1M)", "Enterprise (>1M)"))
  )

# FILTER FOR LARGEST FAILED INVOICES
large_failed_invoices <- failed_cases %>%
  filter(is_failure == TRUE & invoice_amount >= 100000) %>%  # Focus on large invoices (100K+)
  arrange(desc(invoice_amount))

cat("Total large failed invoices (100K+):", nrow(large_failed_invoices), "\n")
cat("Total value of large failed invoices:", sum(large_failed_invoices$invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# PLOT 1: LARGEST FAILED INVOICES BY AMOUNT
p1 <- large_failed_invoices %>%
  head(20) %>%  # Top 20 largest failed invoices
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(invoice_id, invoice_amount), y = invoice_amount)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#E74C3C", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::dollar(invoice_amount)), 
            hjust = -0.1, size = 2, fontface = "bold") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 20 Largest Failed Invoices by Amount",
    subtitle = "Highest value invoices that experienced process failures",
    x = "Invoice ID",
    y = "Invoice Amount"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)
  )

print(p1)
ggsave("largest_failed_invoices.png", p1, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 2: FAILURE DISTRIBUTION BY AMOUNT CATEGORY
failure_by_amount_category <- failed_cases %>%
  filter(is_failure == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(amount_category) %>%
  summarise(
    total_failed = n(),
    total_amount = sum(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_amount = mean(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    failure_rate = n() / nrow(failed_cases) * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(amount_category))

p2 <- ggplot(failure_by_amount_category, 
             aes(x = amount_category, y = total_amount)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#3498DB", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::dollar(total_amount)), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 2, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar) +
  labs(
    title = "Total Failed Invoice Value by Amount Category",
    subtitle = "Cumulative value of failed invoices across different size categories",
    x = "Invoice Amount Category",
    y = "Total Failed Amount"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11)
  )

print(p2)
ggsave("failed_amounts_by_category.png", p2, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 3: FAILURE TYPES FOR LARGE INVOICES
large_failures_by_type <- large_failed_invoices %>%
  group_by(failure_type) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    total_amount = sum(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_amount = mean(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_amount = max(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_amount))

p3 <- ggplot(large_failures_by_type, 
             aes(x = reorder(failure_type, -total_amount), y = total_amount)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#9B59B6", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::dollar(total_amount)), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 2, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar) +
  labs(
    title = "Failure Types for Large Invoices (100K+)",
    subtitle = "Total value of failed invoices by failure type",
    x = "Failure Type",
    y = "Total Failed Amount"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11)
  )

print(p3)
ggsave("large_failures_by_type.png", p3, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 4: VENDORS WITH LARGEST FAILED INVOICES
vendor_failure_analysis <- large_failed_invoices %>%
  group_by(vendor_id) %>%
  summarise(
    failed_invoices = n(),
    total_failed_amount = sum(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_failed_amount = mean(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_failed_amount = max(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_failed_amount)) %>%
  head(15)  # Top 15 vendors by total failed amount

p4 <- ggplot(vendor_failure_analysis, 
             aes(x = reorder(vendor_id, -total_failed_amount), y = total_failed_amount)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#E67E22", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::dollar(total_failed_amount)), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 2, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Vendors by Total Failed Invoice Value",
    subtitle = "Vendors with highest cumulative value of failed invoices (100K+)",
    x = "Vendor ID",
    y = "Total Failed Amount"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10)
  )

print(p4)
ggsave("vendors_largest_failures.png", p4, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 5: GL ACCOUNTS WITH LARGEST FAILED INVOICES
gl_account_failures <- large_failed_invoices %>%
  group_by(gl_account) %>%
  summarise(
    failed_invoices = n(),
    total_failed_amount = sum(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_failed_amount = mean(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_failed_amount)) %>%
  head(15)  # Top 15 GL accounts

p5 <- ggplot(gl_account_failures, 
             aes(x = reorder(gl_account, -total_failed_amount), y = total_failed_amount)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#1ABC9C", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::dollar(total_failed_amount)), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 2, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 GL Accounts by Total Failed Invoice Value",
    subtitle = "General Ledger accounts with highest failed invoice amounts (100K+)",
    x = "GL Account",
    y = "Total Failed Amount"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9)
  )

print(p5)
ggsave("gl_accounts_largest_failures.png", p5, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 6: TREEMAP OF LARGEST FAILED INVOICES BY VENDOR AND FAILURE TYPE
library(treemap)

treemap_data <- large_failed_invoices %>%
  group_by(vendor_id, failure_type) %>%

# PLOT 8: FAILURE RATE BY AMOUNT CATEGORY
failure_rates <- failed_cases %>%

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11)
  )

print(p8)
ggsave("failure_rate_by_amount_category.png", p8, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# DETAILED ANALYSIS OF TOP 10 LARGEST FAILED INVOICES
cat("\n=== TOP 10 LARGEST FAILED INVOICES DETAILED ANALYSIS ===\n")

top_10_failures <- large_failed_invoices %>%
  head(10) %>%
  select(invoice_id, invoice_amount, failure_type, vendor_id, gl_account, 
         processing_days, n_activities)

print(top_10_failures)

# Calculate financial impact
financial_impact <- list()
financial_impact$total_failed_amount <- sum(large_failed_invoices$invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE)
financial_impact$avg_failed_amount <- mean(large_failed_invoices$invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE)
financial_impact$max_failed_amount <- max(large_failed_invoices$invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE)
financial_impact$failed_invoices_count <- nrow(large_failed_invoices)

cat("\nFINANCIAL IMPACT SUMMARY:\n")
cat("Total failed amount (100K+ invoices):", scales::dollar(financial_impact$total_failed_amount), "\n")
cat("Average failed invoice amount:", scales::dollar(financial_impact$avg_failed_amount), "\n")
cat("Largest single failed invoice:", scales::dollar(financial_impact$max_failed_amount), "\n")
cat("Number of large failed invoices:", financial_impact$failed_invoices_count, "\n")

# VENDOR RISK ANALYSIS
vendor_risk <- large_failed_invoices %>%
  group_by(vendor_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_failed_amount = sum(invoice_amount),
    failed_invoice_count = n(),
    avg_failed_amount = mean(invoice_amount),
    failure_types = paste(unique(failure_type), collapse = ", ")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_failed_amount))

cat("\nTOP 5 HIGHEST RISK VENDORS:\n")
print(vendor_risk %>% head(5))

# Save detailed analysis files
write.csv(large_failed_invoices, "largest_failed_invoices_detailed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(vendor_risk, "vendor_risk_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(failure_rates, "failure_rates_by_amount.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n=== ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Generated 8 comprehensive visualizations of largest failed invoice types\n")
cat("Detailed analysis saved to CSV files for further investigation\n")
```

```{r}
# FIXED CODE FOR DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS PLOTS
library(ggplot2)

# Ensure dplyr is properly loaded

}

# Re-import and clean data properly
raw_data <- read.csv("INN354 2025H Event log.csv")

# Convert dates properly - handle NA values
raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(strptime(timestamp, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")),
    invoice_date = as.POSIXct(strptime(invoice_date, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")),
    scan_date = as.POSIXct(strptime(scan_date, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")),
    invoice_id = as.factor(invoice_id)
  )

# BASIC DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS
cat("=== BASIC DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS ===\n")

# 1. TIMESTAMP RANGE
timestamp_range <- range(raw_data$timestamp, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("1. TIMESTAMP RANGE:\n")
cat("   Earliest:", as.character(timestamp_range[1]), "\n")
cat("   Latest:  ", as.character(timestamp_range[2]), "\n")

# 2. INVOICE AMOUNT
invoice_stats <- raw_data %>%
  distinct(invoice_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    min_amount = min(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_amount = max(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_amount = mean(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_amount = median(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

cat("2. INVOICE AMOUNT:\n")
cat("   Smallest: $", format(invoice_stats$min_amount, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("   Largest:  $", format(invoice_stats$max_amount, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("   Average:  $", format(round(invoice_stats$avg_amount), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("   Median:   $", format(round(invoice_stats$median_amount), big.mark = ","), "\n\n")

# 3. INVOICE DATE RANGE
invoice_date_range <- range(raw_data$invoice_date, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("3. INVOICE DATE RANGE:\n")
cat("   Earliest:", as.character(invoice_date_range[1]), "\n")
cat("   Latest:  ", as.character(invoice_date_range[2]), "\n\n")

# 4. SCAN DATE RANGE
scan_date_range <- range(raw_data$scan_date, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("4. SCAN DATE RANGE:\n")
cat("   Earliest:", as.character(scan_date_range[1]), "\n")
cat("   Latest:  ", as.character(scan_date_range[2]), "\n\n")

# 5. APPROVER COUNTS
first_approvers <- raw_data$first_approver_id[!is.na(raw_data$first_approver_id)] %>% unique()
second_approvers <- raw_data$second_approver_id[!is.na(raw_data$second_approver_id)] %>% unique()

cat("   Unique Second Approvers:", length(second_approvers), "\n\n")

# CREATE THE PLOTS
cat("Creating descriptive statistics plots...\n")

# PLOT 1: TIMELINE OVERVIEW
timeline_data <- data.frame(
  Event_Type = c("First Process Event", "Last Process Event", 
                 "Earliest Invoice Date", "Latest Invoice Date",
                 "Earliest Scan Date", "Latest Scan Date"),
  DateTime = c(
    min(raw_data$timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(raw_data$timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    min(raw_data$invoice_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(raw_data$invoice_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    min(raw_data$scan_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(raw_data$scan_date, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

p1 <- ggplot(timeline_data, aes(x = DateTime, y = reorder(Event_Type, DateTime), color = Event_Type)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = DateTime, yend = Event_Type, x = min(DateTime)), size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "Process Timeline Overview",
    subtitle = "Key date ranges across different event types",
    x = "Date",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +

  scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%b %Y")

# PLOT 2: INVOICE AMOUNT DISTRIBUTION
p2 <- ggplot(raw_data %>% distinct(invoice_id, .keep_all = TRUE),

  labs(
    title = "Invoice Amount Distribution",

    x = "Invoice Amount ($)",
    y = "Number of Invoices"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +

# PLOT 3: DATA QUALITY - MISSING VALUES
missing_data <- data.frame(
  Field = c("timestamp", "invoice_date", "scan_date", "first_approver", "second_approver"),
  Missing_Count = c(
    sum(is.na(raw_data$timestamp)),
    sum(is.na(raw_data$invoice_date)),

) %>%

p3 <- ggplot(missing_data, aes(x = reorder(Field, -Missing_Percentage), y = Missing_Percentage, fill = Missing_Percentage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Missing_Percentage, 1), "%")), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +

  labs(
    title = "Data Quality Assessment",

    x = "Data Field",

  theme_minimal() +
```

```{r}
# INVOICE CATEGORY OVERVIEW AND POSTING TYPE ANALYSIS

# 1. INVOICE AMOUNT CATEGORIES BREAKDOWN
amount_categories <- raw_data %>%
  distinct(invoice_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    amount_category = cut(invoice_amount,
                         breaks = c(0, 1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 500000, Inf),
                         labels = c("0-1K", "1K-5K", "5K-10K", "10K-50K", "50K-100K", "100K-500K", "500K+"),
                         include.lowest = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  count(amount_category, name = "invoice_count") %>%
  mutate(percentage = invoice_count / sum(invoice_count) * 100)

# Plot 1: Invoice Amount Categories
p1 <- ggplot(amount_categories, aes(x = amount_category, y = invoice_count, fill = amount_category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(invoice_count, "\n(", round(percentage, 1), "%)")), 
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  labs(
    title = "Invoice Distribution by Amount Categories",
    subtitle = "Breakdown of invoices by value ranges",
    x = "Amount Category ($)",
    y = "Number of Invoices",
    fill = "Amount Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 2. MANUAL VS AUTOMATIC POSTING ANALYSIS
posting_analysis <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  summarise(
    has_manual_posting = any(activity_id == "Posted manually"),
    has_auto_posting = any(activity_id == "FI Posted Automatically"),
    final_status = last(activity_id)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    posting_type = case_when(
      has_manual_posting ~ "Manual Posting",
      has_auto_posting ~ "Automatic Posting",
      TRUE ~ "No Posting/Other"
    )
  )

posting_summary <- posting_analysis %>%
  count(posting_type, name = "invoice_count") %>%
  mutate(percentage = invoice_count / sum(invoice_count) * 100)

# Plot 2: Manual vs Automatic Posting
p2 <- ggplot(posting_summary, aes(x = posting_type, y = invoice_count, fill = posting_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(invoice_count, "\n(", round(percentage, 1), "%)")), 
            vjust = -0.3, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Manual Posting" = "#FF6B6B", 
                              "Automatic Posting" = "#4ECDC4", 
                              "No Posting/Other" = "#95A5A6")) +
  labs(
    title = "Manual vs Automatic Invoice Posting",
    subtitle = "Distribution of posting methods across all invoices",
    x = "Posting Type",
    y = "Number of Invoices",
    fill = "Posting Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# 3. DETAILED POSTING STATUS BREAKDOWN
detailed_posting <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(invoice_id) %>%
  summarise(
    final_activity = last(activity_id),
    invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    posting_status = case_when(
      final_activity == "Posted manually" ~ "Manually Posted",
      final_activity == "FI Posted Automatically" ~ "Automatically Posted",
      final_activity == "Invoice document deleted" ~ "Deleted",
      final_activity == "Approval rejected" ~ "Rejected",
      final_activity %in% c("Sent for approval", "On hold at approver") ~ "Pending Approval",
      TRUE ~ "Other Status"
    )
  )

detailed_summary <- detailed_posting %>%
  count(posting_status, name = "invoice_count") %>%
  mutate(percentage = invoice_count / sum(invoice_count) * 100) %>%
  arrange(desc(invoice_count))

# Plot 3: Detailed Posting Status
p3 <- ggplot(detailed_summary, aes(x = reorder(posting_status, -invoice_count), y = invoice_count, fill = posting_status)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(invoice_count, "\n(", round(percentage, 1), "%)")), 
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Detailed Invoice Posting Status",
    subtitle = "Final status breakdown of all invoices",
    x = "Final Status",
    y = "Number of Invoices",
    fill = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 4. POSTING TYPE BY AMOUNT CATEGORY
posting_by_amount <- raw_data %>%
  distinct(invoice_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    amount_category = cut(invoice_amount,
                         breaks = c(0, 1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 500000, Inf),
                         labels = c("0-1K", "1K-5K", "5K-10K", "10K-50K", "50K-100K", "100K-500K", "500K+"),
                         include.lowest = TRUE),
    posting_type = case_when(
      activity_id == "Posted manually" ~ "Manual",
      activity_id == "FI Posted Automatically" ~ "Automatic",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(posting_type %in% c("Manual", "Automatic")) %>%
  count(amount_category, posting_type, name = "count")

# Plot 4: Posting Type by Amount Category
p4 <- ggplot(posting_by_amount, aes(x = amount_category, y = count, fill = posting_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), 
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Manual" = "#FF6B6B", "Automatic" = "#4ECDC4")) +
  labs(
    title = "Posting Method by Invoice Amount Category",
    subtitle = "Comparison of manual vs automatic posting across different value ranges",
    x = "Amount Category ($)",
    y = "Number of Invoices",
    fill = "Posting Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 5. FINANCIAL IMPACT OF POSTING TYPES
financial_impact <- raw_data %>%
  distinct(invoice_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    posting_type = case_when(
      activity_id == "Posted manually" ~ "Manual Posting",
      activity_id == "FI Posted Automatically" ~ "Automatic Posting",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(posting_type %in% c("Manual Posting", "Automatic Posting")) %>%
  group_by(posting_type) %>%
  summarise(
    total_amount = sum(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_amount = mean(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    invoice_count = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage_of_total = total_amount / sum(total_amount) * 100
  )

# Plot 5: Financial Impact
p5 <- ggplot(financial_impact, aes(x = posting_type, y = total_amount/1000000, fill = posting_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("$", round(total_amount/1000000, 1), "M\n", 
                              round(percentage_of_total, 1), "%")), 
            vjust = -0.3, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Manual Posting" = "#FF6B6B", "Automatic Posting" = "#4ECDC4")) +
  labs(
    title = "Financial Impact: Manual vs Automatic Posting",
    subtitle = "Total invoice value by posting method (in millions)",
    x = "Posting Type",
    y = "Total Amount (Millions $)",
    fill = "Posting Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# SAVE ALL PLOTS
ggsave("invoice_amount_categories.png", p1, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave("manual_vs_auto_posting.png", p2, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave("detailed_posting_status.png", p3, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave("posting_by_amount_category.png", p4, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(stringr)
library(treemap)

# Set working directory
#setwd("C:/Users/Khali/Desktop/INN351 and INN354/INN354")

# Import data
raw_data <- read.csv("INN354 2025H Event log.csv")
raw_data$timestamp <- as.POSIXct(strptime(raw_data$timestamp, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))

# ANALYSIS: GROUP FAILED POSTINGS BY ROOT CAUSE
cat("=== FAILED POSTINGS ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Define root cause classification function
classify_root_cause <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    group_by(invoice_id) %>%
    summarise(
      # Basic information
      invoice_amount = first(invoice_amount),
      vendor_id = first(vendor_id),
      gl_account = first(gl_account),
      cost_center = first(cost_center_id),
      profit_center = first(profit_center_id),
      currency = first(currency_id),
      
      # Activity patterns for root cause analysis
      activity_sequence = paste(activity_id, collapse = " -> "),
      has_manual_posting = any(activity_id == "Posted manually"),
      has_auto_posting = any(activity_id == "FI Posted Automatically"),
      has_rejection = any(activity_id == "Approval rejected"),
      has_hold = any(activity_id == "On hold at approver"),
      has_comment_request = any(activity_id == "Asked for Comment"),
      has_goods_receipt = any(activity_id == "Get goods receipt from WM"),
      has_initial_validation = any(activity_id == "Initial validation"),
      has_data_management = any(activity_id == "Data management"),
      n_approval_cycles = sum(activity_id == "Sent for approval"),
      final_status = last(activity_id),
      processing_days = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(timestamp), units = "days")),
      
      # Root cause classification based on activity patterns
      root_cause = case_when(
        # Master Data Issues
        has_goods_receipt & has_manual_posting & !has_rejection ~ "Incorrect/Incomplete Master Data",
        has_initial_validation & has_data_management & has_manual_posting & n_approval_cycles == 0 ~ "Master Data Validation Failure",
        
        # Tax Code Issues
        str_detect(activity_sequence, "Approval rejected.*tax|tax.*Approval rejected") ~ "Wrong/Missing Tax Codes",
        has_comment_request & str_detect(activity_sequence, "validation.*Approval") ~ "Tax Code Configuration",
        
        # G/L or Cost Account Issues
        (is.na(gl_account) | gl_account == "") & has_manual_posting ~ "Missing G/L Account",
        (is.na(cost_center) | cost_center == "") & has_manual_posting ~ "Missing Cost Center",
        (is.na(profit_center) | profit_center == "") & has_manual_posting ~ "Missing Profit Center",
        has_rejection & has_data_management & n_approval_cycles > 1 ~ "Account Assignment Issues",
        
        # System Configuration Issues
        has_auto_posting & has_manual_posting ~ "System Configuration Conflict",
        has_hold & processing_days > 7 ~ "System Workflow Configuration",
        n_approval_cycles > 2 ~ "Approval Workflow Configuration",
        
        # Process Exceptions
        final_status == "Invoice document deleted" ~ "Process Exception - Invoice Deleted",
        processing_days > 30 ~ "Process Exception - Stuck in System",
        
        # Default classification based on most common pattern
        has_rejection ~ "Approval Process Failure",
        has_manual_posting ~ "Manual Processing Required",
        TRUE ~ "Other/Unclassified"
      ),
      
      # Sub-category for more detailed analysis
      root_cause_subcategory = case_when(
        root_cause == "Incorrect/Incomplete Master Data" & has_goods_receipt ~ "Vendor Master Data",
        root_cause == "Incorrect/Incomplete Master Data" & !has_goods_receipt ~ "Material Master Data",
        root_cause == "Wrong/Missing Tax Codes" ~ "Tax Code Configuration",
        root_cause %in% c("Missing G/L Account", "Missing Cost Center", "Missing Profit Center") ~ "Account Assignment",
        root_cause == "System Configuration Conflict" ~ "Posting Interface Issues",
        TRUE ~ root_cause
      ),
      
      is_failure = root_cause != "Other/Unclassified" & 
        (has_manual_posting | has_rejection | final_status == "Invoice document deleted")
    )
}

# Apply root cause classification
root_cause_analysis <- classify_root_cause(raw_data)

# Filter for failed cases only
failed_cases <- root_cause_analysis %>%
  filter(is_failure == TRUE)

cat("Total failed cases identified:", nrow(failed_cases), "\n")
cat("Total value of failed invoices:", sum(failed_cases$invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# PLOT 1: FAILED POSTINGS BY ROOT CAUSE (COUNT)
root_cause_summary <- failed_cases %>%
  group_by(root_cause) %>%
  summarise(
    case_count = n(),
    total_amount = sum(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_amount = mean(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_amount = max(invoice_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_processing_days = mean(processing_days, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(case_count))

p1 <- ggplot(root_cause_summary, 
             aes(x = reorder(root_cause, -case_count), y = case_count)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#E74C3C", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(case_count)), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  labs(
    title = "Failed Postings by Root Cause (Volume)",
    subtitle = "Number of failed invoices categorized by primary root cause",
    x = "Root Cause Category",
    y = "Number of Failed Invoices"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11)
  )

print(p1)
ggsave("failed_postings_by_root_cause_count.png", p1, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# PLOT 2: FAILED POSTINGS BY ROOT CAUSE (FINANCIAL IMPACT)

  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#3498DB", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::dollar(total_amount)), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar) +
  labs(
    title = "Failed Postings by Root Cause (Financial Impact)",
    subtitle = "Total value of failed invoices by root cause category",
    x = "Root Cause Category",
    y = "Total Failed Amount"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11)
  )

print(p2)

# PLOT 3: AVERAGE INVOICE AMOUNT BY ROOT CAUSE
```
